text: Local Commander 是面向 DSH Web 的远程电脑 MCP 连接配置。它通过 DSH 的 MCP 客户端以 stdio 启动 mcp-remote，并连接 localcmd.app 的 MCP 服务。配置支持 OAuth 浏览器登录和令牌刷新，让 DSH 能调用该服务提供的工具；这些工具可用于在配对电脑上执行任务、访问文件和检查本机服务，具体能力由远端服务决定。适合需要从 DSH 会话连接已配对电脑的用户；需要 Local Commander 账户及本机 Node.js/npx。

Local Commander connects DSH Web to its remote MCP service. The DSH bundle starts mcp-remote over stdio for localcmd.app, with browser OAuth sign-in and token refresh. DSH can call remote tools for paired computer tasks. Requires a Local Commander account and Node.js/npx.

让 DSH 能连接 Local Commander 提供的远程工具
怎么给 DSH Web 配置一个需要 OAuth 登录的 MCP 服务
我想从手机上的聊天继续操作已配对的电脑
Connect my DSH session to a paired computer through MCP
Let an AI chat reach my remote machines using browser OAuth
How can I expose a hosted computer service as DSH tools?
Local Commander 的功能「dsh-mcp」：DSH MCP 连接：将名为 local-commander 的服务器插入 DSH MCP 客户端配置，并通过 stdio 启动 mcp-remote 连接远端地址。
Local Commander 的功能「oauth」：浏览器 OAuth 登录：首次使用由 mcp-remote 为 localcmd.app 执行 OAuth 登录并维持令牌刷新。
Local Commander 的功能「client-tools」：远端工具接入：连接建立后，DSH 可呈现 Local Commander MCP 服务提供的工具；实际工具及其输入输出由远端服务决定。
Local Commander 的功能「paired-machines」：配对电脑任务：通过服务连接已配对的电脑，并在 AI 聊天中请求远端服务支持的电脑任务。
Local Commander 使用前须知：DSH 连接 localcmd.app 的远程 MCP 服务，OAuth 登录及令牌桥接由 mcp-remote 处理；服务端功能超出本仓库配置范围。

local-commander-dsh README · Local Commander for Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Antigravity, Kiro and LM Studio：[](https://m8ven.ai/mcp/netbka-local-commander-plugins-1j2wd2?s=readme)

Connects Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Antigravity, Kiro and LM Studio to [Local Commander](https://localcmd.app) at `https://localcmd.app/mcp`. Your AI gets hands on every computer you own: it can run commands and scripts, change settings, edit files and check local services on any of them, from one chat. Your workspace at localcmd.app shows which computer ran each request and how it ended.
section: Local Commander for Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Antigravity, Kiro and LM Studio

text: local-commander-dsh README · Local Commander for Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Antigravity, Kiro and LM Studio：This repository holds configuration only: a Cursor plugin, a DeepSeek Harness bundle, an Antigravity plugin, a Kiro Power and LM Studio settings. The service runs at localcmd.app.
section: Local Commander for Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Antigravity, Kiro and LM Studio

text:
local-commander-dsh README · Requirements：- A Local Commander account at [localcmd.app](https://localcmd.app).
- A Windows 11 x64 computer with Node.js 20 or later and the paired agent: run `npx local-commander-agent@latest` on it, then choose full access or selected folders.
- The computer must be online for work and for reading results.

local-commander-dsh README · Requirements：Once you approve a computer and connect your AI, it can do what your Windows account can do, just like you at the keyboard. You can limit it to certain folders, block commands, stop running work, or switch a computer off from the site at any time. Every run shows which computer did it. Whatever the AI asks for goes back to the AI.

local-commander-dsh README · Cursor：- **The agent reports no computers:** start the agent on the Windows computer and check that it shows as online at localcmd.app.
- **Sign-in loops or fails:** open Output, choose "MCP Logs", and check the OAuth error; then remove and re-add the server.
- **A result is unknown:** the computer dropped during the task. The work is not re-run automatically; check the computer and ask again.
local-commander-dsh README · DeepSeek Harness：A configuration-only [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle. The tools appear as `mcp__local-commander__<tool>`.

local-commander-dsh README · DeepSeek Harness：The harness MCP client sends static headers only, so the bundle starts [`mcp-remote`](https://github.com/punkpeye/mcp-remote) over stdio. On first use it opens localcmd.app in your browser to sign in and approve access (OAuth 2.0), then keeps the token refreshed. In your localcmd.app workspace these requests show the client name "MCP CLI Proxy", the name mcp-remote registers.

DeepSeek Harness asks for Node.js 22.19 or later on the machine where you chat.

local-commander-dsh README · DeepSeek Harness：Install: download `local-commander-dsh-1.0.0.tgz` from the [latest release](https://github.com/netbka/local-commander-plugins/releases/latest), then run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./local-commander-dsh-1.0.0.tgz
dsh web
```

You can also build the tarball from this repository with `npm pack`.

Remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove local-commander-dsh
```

local-commander-dsh README · Antigravity：This repository is also an Antigravity plugin (`.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json` plus `mcp_config.json`). Like the DeepSeek Harness bundle, it starts [`mcp-remote`](https://github.com/punkpeye/mcp-remote) over stdio, which opens localcmd.app in your browser to sign in and approve access (OAuth 2.0) and keeps the token refreshed. Requests show the client name "MCP CLI Proxy" in your localcmd.app workspace.

Install:

```sh
agy plugin install https://github.com/netbka/local-commander-plugins
```
local-commander-dsh README · Antigravity：Or clone the repository and run `agy plugin install <folder>`. Remove with `agy plugin uninstall local-commander`.

local-commander-dsh README · Kiro：The `kiro-power/` folder is a Kiro Power in the Agent Plugins format (`plugin.json` and `mcp.json`). It points Kiro at the remote server `https://localcmd.app/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), which uses OAuth 2.0 sign-in at localcmd.app.

Install: in Kiro, open the Powers panel, choose **Add Custom Power**, then **Import power from GitHub**, and enter `https://github.com/netbka/local-commander-plugins/tree/main/kiro-power`.

local-commander-dsh README · LM Studio：[LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai) 0.3.17 or later runs MCP servers listed in its `mcp.json`. Like the DeepSeek Harness bundle, the entry starts [`mcp-remote`](https://github.com/punkpeye/mcp-remote) over stdio, which opens localcmd.app in your browser to sign in and approve access (OAuth 2.0) and keeps the token refreshed. Requests show the client name "MCP CLI Proxy" in your localcmd.app workspace. The computer running LM Studio needs Node.js 20 or later.

local-commander-dsh README · LM Studio：2. In a chat, turn on `mcp/local-commander` and choose a model that supports tool calls. On first use your browser opens localcmd.app to sign in and approve access.
3. Ask the model to list your computers, then work on an approved project.
